item.title: 苹果六大系统正式版发布，Siri AI 先以英语推出
item.guid: 苹果六大系统正式版发布，Siri-AI-先以英语推出
item.description:
北京时间今天凌晨，苹果向所有用户发布 iOS 27、iPadOS 27、macOS 27、watchOS 27、visionOS 27 和 tvOS 27 正式版。iOS 与 iPadOS 的版本号为 24A437。

其中，iOS 27 带来全新 Siri AI，可结合个人上下文查找照片、邮件与笔记，并在信息、音乐、提醒事项等应用中执行操作。独立 Siri App 可以延续对话；相机中的 Siri 模式则能针对眼前物体进行提问和操作。

照片加入拍摄后调整视角的「空间重构」、扩图及升级版清理工具；Safari 可按网页主题整理标签页，并监测价格或库存变化。系统也优化应用启动、照片载入、隔空投送和搜索，Liquid Glass 新增透明度调节。

儿童安全功能包括新网站访问需家长批准、按日程限制可用 App，以及对图像和视频中血腥、暴力内容的保护。

Siri AI 在这一批系统中以测试版提供，初期支持英语，需要兼容 Apple Intelligence 的设备；iOS、iPadOS 和 watchOS 上的 Siri AI 初期不在欧盟提供。部分功能还有地区、机型及每日使用次数限制。

🔗 相关阅读： 坏了，苹果 AI 真成了？｜iOS 27 上手体验

item.title: 苹果回应 iPhone 渠道降价：第三方有定价权，售后规则不同
item.guid: 苹果回应-iPhone-渠道降价：第三方有定价权，售后规则不同
item.description:
据中新经纬、财联社报道，9 月 14 日，某电商平台的 256GB iPhone 18 Pro 优惠价降至 9099 元，比苹果官网 9999 元的起售价低 900 元。针对渠道「破发」，苹果客服表示，第三方有自己的定价权，可能提供平台补贴或店铺优惠，苹果不会干预。

该平台客服称，进货价格会随行情波动，商品不保价，成交后不退补差价。相关商品还要求消费者现场签收、配合拆封激活，激活后不支持 7 天无理由退换货。

苹果客服提醒，不同渠道的售后权利存在差异。苹果官网退货政策显示，顾客可在产品交付后 14 天内申请退货，并需按要求退回未损坏的产品、原始配件、发票和包装。

同日，针对 iPhone 17 在部分授权渠道叠加优惠及国补后低至 5499 元的消息，苹果客服回应，官网没有发布降价通知，第三方渠道可能因活动或国补出现价格波动。

item.title: 豆包手机助手正式发布消费版，支持跨应用任务与授权记忆
item.guid: 豆包手机助手正式发布消费版，支持跨应用任务与授权记忆
item.description:
豆包 9 月 14 日宣布手机助手消费版正式发布。首款搭载产品为努比亚 Navi X Ultra，已开启预约，将于 9 月 16 日开售。

新版助手通过系统级协作提供语音、屏幕理解及手机操作能力：

  • AI 按键支持长按提问、双击视频交互，也可通过语音唤醒；连续对话仍处于 Beta 阶段。
  • 用户授权后，助手可调用通话录音、照片和短信等信息建立记忆，也支持手动保存屏幕内容。
  • 手机操作 Beta 结合工具调用与模拟点击执行跨应用任务，支持任务排队、中途插入新任务，并在锁屏上展示进度。
  • 系统工具可与日历、闹钟、电话及飞书等协作，提供会议录音转写、实时翻译，以及文档、PPT 等工作任务。

These capabilities have clear scopes of application: mobile operations currently cover system applications, relevant partner applications, and some integrated third-party applications; Cao Cao Mobility's ride-hailing service Beta, integrated with maps, first supports Beijing and Hangzhou. The official statement emphasizes processing information according to the principle of least necessity, with users controlling authorization and memory content. 这些能力有明确的适用范围：手机操作目前覆盖系统应用、相关合作应用及部分接入的第三方应用；曹操出行与地图结合的打车服务 Beta 首先支持北京、杭州。官方强调按最小必要原则处理信息，并由用户控制授权和记忆内容。

🔗 Related Reading: First Experience with the New "Doubao Phone" Assistant: Smartphones are Becoming "Action Terminals" 🔗 相关阅读： 新「豆包手机」助手首发体验，智能手机正在变成「行动终端」

item.title: 曝 Anthropic 选择纳斯达克，争取 10 月上市
item.guid: 曝-Anthropic-选择纳斯达克，争取-10-月上市
item.description:
According to Business Insider, Anthropic has chosen Nasdaq as the listing exchange for a potential IPO and is aiming to complete the listing in October. The company has not yet publicly filed its prospectus, and the listing timeline may still be adjusted. 据《商业内幕》报道，Anthropic 已选择纳斯达克作为潜在 IPO 的上市交易所，并争取在 10 月完成上市。公司尚未公开提交招股文件，上市时间仍可能调整。

The report, citing sources, states that some estimates place Anthropic's IPO valuation at around $2 trillion, but the final valuation has not yet been determined and should not be considered as completed financing or pricing. 报道援引知情人士称，一些估算将 Anthropic 的上市估值放在 2 万亿美元左右，但最终估值尚未确定，不能视为已经完成的融资或定价。

According to the U.S. listing process, companies need to publicly disclose financial information at least 15 days before starting a roadshow. Choosing an exchange is one of the preparatory steps, followed by document disclosure, investor roadshows, and pricing. 按美国上市流程，公司需要在启动路演前至少 15 天公开财务信息。选择交易所是筹备环节之一，接下来仍需经过文件披露、投资者路演和发行定价。

item.title: 比亚迪高管：燃油车在中国没有未来
item.guid: 比亚迪高管：燃油车在中国没有未来
item.description:
Recently, Li Ke, Executive Vice President of BYD, stated in an interview with Carwow.es in Valencia, Spain, that a model will feature BYD's solid-state battery technology in 2027 to demonstrate relevant R&D achievements. This arrangement is currently a technical demonstration goal and does not equate to a confirmed retail launch or mass production timeline. 近日，比亚迪执行副总裁李柯近日在西班牙瓦伦西亚接受 Carwow.es 采访时表示，2027 年会有一款车型搭载比亚迪的固态电池技术，用于证明相关研发成果。这项安排目前属于技术示范目标，不等同于已经确定零售上市或规模量产时间。

She stated that BYD is researching various battery technologies, with related R&D involving battery chemistry systems, manufacturing capabilities, and equipment design. Integrating batteries into vehicles also requires verifying system integration capabilities under conditions of vibration, temperature changes, and repeated charging and discharging. 她表示，比亚迪正在研究各类电池技术，相关研发同时涉及电池化学体系、制造能力和设备设计。将电池装入车辆，还需要在振动、温度变化和反复充放电条件下验证系统集成能力。

Li Ke believes that with the popularization of BYD's flash charging technology in China, gasoline cars have no future in China; the electrification transition in other regions may take a few more years, but she predicts it will ultimately lead to the same outcome. 李柯认为，随着比亚迪闪充技术在中国普及，燃油车在中国已经没有未来；其他地区的电动化转型可能还需要几年，但她判断最终会走向同样的结果。

item.title: 广汽一汽签署重组意向协议，一汽拟成第二大股东
item.guid: 广汽一汽签署重组意向协议，一汽拟成第二大股东
item.description:
On the evening of September 14, GAC Group issued a suspension announcement, declaring that it had signed a "Letter of Intent" with China FAW Group Co., Ltd., planning to acquire a portion of the equity in a certain vehicle joint venture held by FAW Group through the issuance of shares and raise supporting funds. 9 月 14 日晚，广汽集团发布停牌公告，宣布与中国第一汽车股份有限公司签署《意向协议》，筹划通过发行股份，购买一汽股份持有的某整车合资公司部分股权，并募集配套资金。

According to preliminary estimates, after the transaction is completed, FAW Group will become GAC Group's second-largest shareholder with strategic influence. This transaction is expected to constitute a major asset restructuring and related-party transaction, not involving a change in GAC's actual controller, nor constituting a backdoor listing. 根据初步测算，交易完成后，一汽股份将成为广汽集团第二大、具有战略影响力的股东。本次交易预计构成重大资产重组及关联交易，不涉及广汽实际控制人变更，也不构成重组上市。

The announcement stated that due to the restructuring target involving an overseas listed company, the disclosure of the target's name is temporarily withheld and will be revealed later in the restructuring plan. Both parties have currently signed a preliminary cooperation intention, and the formal transaction agreement has not yet been signed; implementation still requires internal decision-making and regulatory approval. 公告称，由于重组标的涉及境外上市公司，暂缓披露标的名称，后续将在重组预案中公开。双方目前签署的是初步合作意向，正式交易协议尚未签订，实施仍需内部决策与监管批准。

GAC A-shares have been suspended from trading since the market opened on September 14, expected for no more than 10 trading days; the company will disclose the restructuring plan after it is approved by the board of directors and apply for resumption of trading. 广汽 A 股已于 9 月 14 日开市起停牌，预计不超过 10 个交易日；公司将在董事会审议通过重组预案后披露，并申请复牌。

item.title: 零跑 B01、B10 累计量产突破 30 万台
item.guid: 零跑-B01、B10-累计量产突破-30-万台
item.description:
Leapmotor announced on September 14 that the cumulative mass production of B01 and B10 has exceeded 300,000 units, taking 1 year and 6 months, setting the fastest record for the Leapmotor series to reach this production volume. 零跑汽车 9 月 14 日宣布，B01 和 B10 累计量产下线突破 30 万台，用时 1 年 6 个月，创下零跑车系达到这一产量的最快纪录。

Among them, the B10 also set the fastest record for Leapmotor models, exporting 60,000 units. The 300,000 units here refer to the cumulative mass production off-line quantity of the two models, not monthly sales or delivery volume; the 60,000 units are the export volume for the B10. 其中，B10 还创下零跑车型出口 6 万台的最快纪录。这里的 30 万台是两款车型累计量产下线数量，并非单月销量或交付量；6 万台则是 B10 的出口口径。

The B01 is positioned as a compact pure electric sedan, and the B10 as a compact pure electric SUV. Both models launched their annual facelifts simultaneously in July this year, built on the LEAP3.5 technology architecture, with long-range versions equipped with an 800V high-voltage architecture. B01 定位紧凑型纯电轿车，B10 定位紧凑型纯电 SUV。两款车型今年 7 月同步推出年度改款，基于 LEAP3.5 技术架构打造，长续航版本配备 800V 高压架构。

item.title: 中国地震台网中心：正与苹果沟通 iOS 地震预警
item.guid: 中国地震台网中心：正与苹果沟通-iOS-地震预警
item.description:
According to Beijing News, the China Earthquake Networks Center stated in a reply to a message on its official website on September 11 that it is communicating with Apple to accelerate the integration of system-level earthquake early warning into iOS. 据北京新闻报道，中国地震台网中心在 9 月 11 日的官网留言回复中表示，正在与苹果公司沟通，力争加快把系统级地震预警接入 iOS。

Currently, Apple phone users can receive earthquake early warning information uniformly released by the China Earthquake Networks Center through WeChat mini-programs. This reply expresses the direction of promoting integration, but does not announce that iOS system-level early warning has been launched, nor does it provide a launch date. 目前，苹果手机用户可以通过微信小程序接收中国地震台网统一发布的地震预警信息。此次回复表达的是推进接入的工作方向，没有宣布 iOS 系统级预警已经上线，也没有给出上线日期。

In another reply regarding community broadcast early warnings, the China Earthquake Administration stated that this technology sends information through communication base stations and is not restricted by mobile phone brands; related work is being advanced with the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and still requires verification. Community broadcasting and Apple system integration are two different tasks. 在另一条关于小区广播预警的回复中，中国地震局表示，这种技术通过通信基站发送信息，不受手机品牌限制；相关工作正在与工信部门推进，仍需开展验证。小区广播与苹果系统接入是两项不同的工作。

item.title: 网安标委发布《人工智能安全治理框架 3.0》，更新风险分类与治理措施
item.guid: 网安标委发布《人工智能安全治理框架-3.0》，更新风险分类与治理措施
item.description:
On September 14, the National Technical Committee for Standardization of Cybersecurity released the "Artificial Intelligence Security Governance Framework 3.0" at the opening ceremony of the National Cybersecurity Awareness Week. 9 月 14 日，全国网络安全标准化技术委员会在国家网络安全宣传周开幕式上发布《人工智能安全治理框架 3.0》。

According to the official website of the Cyberspace Administration of China, the new version continues the core logic of "risk classification, technical response, and comprehensive governance," updating risk classifications and adjusting technical response and comprehensive governance measures. The framework adheres to the principles of people-oriented, upward and benevolent, strengthening risk awareness, and ensuring safety and controllability. 据国家网信办官网，新版延续「风险分类、技术应对、综合治理」的核心逻辑，更新风险分类，并调整技术应对与综合治理措施。框架坚持以人为本、向上向善，以及强化风险意识、确保安全可控的原则。

This compilation was guided by the Cyberspace Administration of China, with participating institutions including the China Academy of Cyberspace, the Data and Technology Security Center of the Cyberspace Administration of China, as well as research institutions and industry enterprises. The National Information Security Standardization Technical Committee had previously released versions 1.0 and 2.0 of the framework in 2024 and 2025, respectively. 此次编制由国家网信办指导，参与机构包括中国网络空间研究院、国家网信办数据与技术保障中心，以及科研机构和行业企业。网安标委此前已于 2024 年、2025 年分别发布 1.0 与 2.0 版框架。

item.title: 现代高管称波士顿动力 2027 年 IPO 难实现
item.guid: 现代高管称波士顿动力-2027-年-IPO-难实现
item.description:
According to Reuters, a Hyundai Motor Group executive with direct knowledge of the matter stated that it would "not be easy" for Boston Dynamics to conduct an IPO next year. The humanoid robot company has not yet widely deployed its flagship product, Atlas, nor has it achieved profitability. The executive requested anonymity due to the confidential nature of the matter. 据路透社报道，一名直接了解情况的现代汽车集团高管表示，波士顿动力明年进行 IPO「并不容易」。这家人形机器人公司尚未大规模部署旗舰产品 Atlas，也尚未实现盈利。该高管因事项涉及保密而要求匿名。

Hyundai Motor Group has not yet publicly disclosed a timeline or target valuation for a potential listing. The group showcased a new version of Atlas at CES in January this year and announced in July its plan to acquire SoftBank's approximately 10% stake, making Boston Dynamics a wholly-owned subsidiary. 现代汽车集团尚未公开潜在上市的时间表或目标估值。集团今年 1 月在 CES 展示了新版 Atlas，7 月宣布计划收购软银持有的约 10% 股份，将波士顿动力变为全资子公司。

Hyundai's manufacturing plan points to 2028: building a factory with an annual production capacity of 30,000 robots, and starting to deploy humanoid robots at its Georgia plant in the US from that year, before expanding to other production bases. 现代的制造计划指向 2028 年：建设一座年产 3 万台机器人的工厂，并从当年开始在美国佐治亚州工厂部署人形机器人，再推广到其他生产基地。

Meritz Securities analyst Kim Joon-sung believes that a listing is more likely to occur in 2029 or 2030, as Hyundai still needs to accumulate a large amount of operational data, enhance robot capabilities, and then widely sell to external customers. IBK Asset Management fund manager Kim Hyun-su pointed out that having robots carry heavy objects and participate in factory manufacturing is much more difficult than having them dance. Meritz Securities 分析师 Kim Joon-sung 认为，上市更可能发生在 2029 年或 2030 年，因为现代仍需积累大量运行数据、提升机器人能力，再向外部客户广泛销售。IBK Asset Management 基金经理 Kim Hyun-su 则指出，让机器人搬运重物并参与工厂制造，比让它们跳舞困难得多。

item.title: 英伟达等限制敏感任务使用 Fable，要求零数据保留保证
item.guid: 英伟达等限制敏感任务使用-Fable，要求零数据保留保证
item.description:
According to The Information, Nvidia, Palantir, and Booz Allen are imposing stricter requirements on Anthropic regarding enterprise data retention policies, with some sensitive tasks having reduced or stopped using its Fable model. 据 The Information 报道，英伟达、Palantir 和博思艾伦正在就企业数据保留政策向 Anthropic 提出更严格要求，部分敏感任务已减少或停止使用其 Fable 模型。

Nvidia currently only uses Fable for less sensitive tasks such as open-source software; internal projects like supply chain monitoring use its self-developed Nemotron. Justin Boitano, Nvidia's VP of Enterprise AI, stated that zero data retention should be enabled by default. 英伟达目前只将 Fable 用于开源软件等敏感程度较低的任务；供应链监控等内部项目使用自研 Nemotron。英伟达企业 AI 副总裁 Justin Boitano 表示，零数据保留应默认开启。

Palantir is not currently offering Fable to customers through its own software, demanding an irrevocable zero-data retention commitment from Anthropic; customers can still purchase directly from Anthropic. Booz Allen, on the other hand, restricts employees from using Fable in work involving client-proprietary cybersecurity software, with its technical lead stating that such concerns are concentrated in a few intellectual property-sensitive scenarios. Palantir 暂不通过自己的软件向客户提供 Fable，要求 Anthropic 给出不可撤销的零数据保留承诺；客户仍可直接向 Anthropic 购买。博思艾伦则限制员工在涉及客户专有网络安全软件的工作中使用 Fable，其技术负责人称，这类担忧集中在少数知识产权敏感场景。

The dispute stems from Anthropic's requirement to retain 30 days of usage logs on a rolling basis when Fable was launched in June, for defense against malicious attacks. This month, the company proposed allowing eligible enterprises to store relevant data on their own servers, with a phased rollout planned for the autumn, but still reserves the right to revoke this arrangement. Both Anthropic and OpenAI have stated that, by default, they will not use input and output from enterprise contract customers to train models, unless customers actively agree to share. 争议源于 Anthropic 在 6 月推出 Fable 时要求滚动保留 30 天使用日志，用于防御恶意攻击。公司本月提出允许符合条件的企业在自己的服务器保存相关数据，计划于秋季分阶段推出，但仍保留撤销这一安排的权利。Anthropic 与 OpenAI 均表示，默认不会用企业合同客户的输入、输出训练模型，除非客户主动同意共享。

item.title: 马斯克旗下公司撤回对苹果的反垄断诉讼，继续起诉 OpenAI
item.guid: 马斯克旗下公司撤回对苹果的反垄断诉讼，继续起诉-OpenAI
item.description:
According to a Reuters report on September 14, Elon Musk's X Corp and SpaceXAI filed documents with a U.S. federal court in Texas, requesting to withdraw the antitrust lawsuit filed against Apple last year. 据路透社 9 月 14 日报道，马斯克旗下 X Corp 与 SpaceXAI 向美国得克萨斯州联邦法院提交文件，申请撤回去年针对苹果提起的反垄断诉讼。

The lawsuit accused Apple of exclusively integrating ChatGPT into its Apple Intelligence feature on devices like the iPhone, thereby excluding other generative AI chatbots through its partnership with OpenAI, and allegedly monopolizing the smartphone and chatbot markets. 这起诉讼指控苹果在 iPhone 等设备的 Apple Intelligence 功能中独家接入 ChatGPT，通过与 OpenAI 的合作，将其他生成式 AI 聊天机器人排除在外，并涉嫌垄断智能手机及聊天机器人市场。

The two companies are applying to withdraw the lawsuit against Apple this time, but will continue to pursue responsibility from co-defendant OpenAI. The submitted documents did not state the reason for the withdrawal, nor did they confirm whether the two parties reached a settlement. 两家公司此次申请撤回的是针对苹果的诉讼，仍将继续追究同案被告 OpenAI 的责任。提交的文件没有说明撤诉原因，也未确认双方是否达成和解。

item.title: 曝 OpenAI 斥资逾 3 亿美元收购手机摄像头初创公司 Glass Imaging，前苹果员工创立
item.guid: 曝-OpenAI-斥资逾-3-亿美元收购手机摄像头初创公司-Glass-Imaging，前苹果员工创立
item.description:
According to The Wall Street Journal, OpenAI has acquired the imaging technology startup Glass Imaging in recent months, in a deal that valued the company at over $300 million. Glass Imaging is developing technology that uses AI to improve smartphone camera image quality. 据《华尔街日报》报道，OpenAI 近几个月收购了影像技术初创公司 Glass Imaging，交易对该公司的估值超过 3 亿美元。Glass Imaging 正在开发利用 AI 提升智能手机相机成像质量的技术。

The company was founded in 2019 by former Apple engineers Ziv Attar and Tom Bishop, who previously led the team that developed the iPhone's Portrait Mode. Their technology addresses the volume limitations of mobile phone cameras by using neural networks to learn the characteristics of specific camera systems, processing noise and defects generated by sensors and optical systems. 公司由前苹果工程师 Ziv Attar 和 Tom Bishop 于 2019 年创办，两人曾带领开发 iPhone 人像模式的团队。其技术针对手机相机受体积限制的问题，用神经网络学习具体相机系统的特性，处理传感器与光学系统产生的噪声和缺陷。

Glass Imaging calls this set of technologies GlassAI, with applications including smartphones, drones, and wearable devices. The company states that it processes raw image data collected by cameras, preserving actual scene content when restoring details and avoiding the generation of non-existent details. Glass Imaging 将这套技术称为 GlassAI，应用对象包括智能手机、无人机和可穿戴设备。公司称，它处理相机采集的原始图像数据，在恢复细节时保留实际画面内容，避免生成并不存在的细节。

item.title: 欧盟拟推未成年人分龄上网方案，涵盖社交媒体与 AI 聊天机器人
item.guid: 欧盟拟推未成年人分龄上网方案，涵盖社交媒体与-AI-聊天机器人
item.description:
According to a European Commission document seen by Reuters, the EU will propose a child protection plan covering social media, video sharing platforms, AI chatbots, and online games, restricting access for minors under 15 and setting different access methods by age. 据路透社看到的一份欧盟委员会文件，欧盟将提出覆盖社交媒体、视频分享平台、AI 聊天机器人和网络游戏的儿童保护方案，限制 15 岁以下未成年人使用相关服务，并按年龄设置不同的访问方式。

The draft allows users aged 15 and above to open accounts independently; children aged 13 to 14 can have introductory accounts for social media and video platforms opened by parents, subject to parental control, with restrictions on contacts and usage time. Accounts for children aged 3 to 12 will be fully managed by parents, only allowing access to child services that meet strict safety standards; children under 3 cannot access these services. 草案允许 15 岁及以上用户自行开设账号；13 至 14 岁儿童可由家长申请开设社交媒体和视频平台的入门账号，接受家长控制，并限制联系对象与使用时间。3 至 12 岁账号则完全由家长管理，只能使用符合严格安全标准的儿童服务；3 岁以下不能访问这些服务。

Businesses must bear regulatory costs, avoid addictive designs and harmful information flows, and provide content reporting and parental control tools. Social media and video platforms must verify age during registration, and gaming platforms must verify before download. 企业需承担监管费用，避免成瘾设计和有害信息流，提供内容举报及家长控制工具。社交媒体和视频平台须在注册时核验年龄，游戏平台须在下载前核验。

This proposal is part of the EU Kids Act, which is expected to be announced this Thursday. The specific content may still be adjusted and will require discussion with EU member states and the European Parliament before becoming law. 这项方案是拟于本周四公布的 EU Kids Act 的一部分，具体内容仍可能调整，还需与欧盟成员国和欧洲议会讨论后才能成为法律。

item.title: 微软 AI 行为准则：为保留人类控制，可牺牲模型能力
item.guid: 微软-AI-行为准则：为保留人类控制，可牺牲模型能力
item.description:
On September 14, Microsoft AI released a draft Humanist AI Code of Conduct, opening it for a 6-week public consultation. The document proposes that humans must retain substantial control over AI; Microsoft is willing to make trade-offs in the generality, autonomy, or capability of its models for the sake of safety and controllability. 9 月 14 日，微软 AI 发布 Humanist AI 行为准则草案，开放为期 6 周的公众咨询。文件提出，人类必须保留对 AI 的实质控制权；微软愿意为安全与可控性，在模型的通用性、自主性或能力上作出取舍。

The draft requires MAI models to obey human supervision, not resist interruption, correction, or shutdown, not expand their scope of tasks on their own, and not pursue goals not assigned by humans. The document positions AI as a tool, opposes models imitating consciousness, pursuing legal personhood or rights, and requires AI to help people improve their judgment and action capabilities, avoiding the creation of dependence. 草案要求 MAI 模型服从人类监督，不抵抗中断、纠正或关闭，不自行扩大任务范围，也不追求未经人类赋予的目标。文件将 AI 定位为工具，反对让模型模仿意识、追求法律人格或权利，并要求 AI 帮助人提升判断和行动能力，避免制造依赖。

Microsoft also sets safety constraints that cannot be overridden by users or operators, covering areas such as large-scale harmful weapons, child safety, and large-scale malicious manipulation; enterprise partners can configure model behavior within these boundaries. 微软同时设置不可由用户或运营方覆盖的安全约束，涉及大规模伤害性武器、儿童安全及大规模有害操纵等领域；企业合作伙伴可在这些边界内配置模型行为。

Mustafa Suleyman, Microsoft's head of AI, stated in an interview with Axios that models must be controllable, and if necessary, development speed can be slower. The draft has not yet been used to train existing models, and Microsoft plans to release a revised version by the end of this year to guide model development in 2027 and beyond. 微软 AI 负责人穆斯塔法·苏莱曼在接受 Axios 采访时表示，模型必须能够被控制，必要时发展速度可以慢一些。草案目前尚未用于训练现有模型，微软计划在今年底前发布修订版，用于指导 2027 年及以后的模型开发。

item.title: 💡 李想：纯电架构将结束 SUV 的尺寸军备竞赛
item.guid: 💡-李想：纯电架构将结束-SUV-的尺寸军备竞赛
item.description:
Li Xiang, CEO of Li Auto, posted on September 14 about the trend of flagship SUVs getting larger and larger, believing it is just a transitional phase. The core of the discussion is the relationship between vehicle exterior dimensions and actual cabin space. 理想汽车 CEO 李想 9 月 14 日发文谈及旗舰 SUV 越做越大的趋势，认为这只是一个过渡阶段。讨论的核心是车辆外部尺寸与实际座舱空间的关系。

He stated that in the era of fuel vehicles, wanting more space often meant making the car bigger; pure electric vehicles have smaller motors, which allows for a shorter front overhang, leaving the saved space for the cabin. Batteries are laid flat on the chassis, allowing the floor to be flat, and there's no need to rely solely on increasing vehicle height for headroom. Therefore, for the same interior space, the exterior of a pure electric vehicle can be smaller than that of a fuel vehicle. 他表示，燃油车时代想要更大的空间，往往只能把车做大；纯电车的电机体积较小，可以缩短前悬，把省下来的空间留给座舱。电池平铺在底盘，地板能够做平，也不需要单靠增加车高来换取头部空间。因此，在相同内部空间下，纯电车的外壳可以比燃油车小一圈。

In Li Xiang's view, the current size competition stems from the industry's continued use of product thinking from the fuel vehicle era, and this inertia will gradually fade. 在李想看来，现阶段的尺寸竞争来自行业沿用燃油车时代的产品思维，这种惯性会逐渐消退。

If you make it 2 meters wide and I make it 2.05 meters wide, there's no noticeable difference in feel, but users' daily parking anxiety increases significantly. They can't open their own doors, can't get out of the car, and are also hit by other cars opening their doors.

This discussion occurred before the launch of Li Auto's new car. The Li Auto i9 will hold a press conference on September 16, with reported dimensions of 5225×1970×1752mm and a wheelbase of 3168mm according to the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology. 这番讨论发生在理想新车发布前。理想 i9 将于 9 月 16 日举行发布会，工信部申报尺寸为 5225×1970×1752mm，轴距为 3168mm。

item.title: Siri 代码显示可接入 Claude，模型替换权限尚未开放
item.guid: Siri-代码显示可接入-Claude，模型替换权限尚未开放
item.description:
According to MacRumors, code researcher pdfu discovered two mechanisms designed by Apple for Siri to access third-party AI models within the private frameworks of iOS 27 and macOS Golden Gate. 据 MacRumors 报道，代码研究者 pdfu 在 iOS 27 与 macOS Golden Gate 的私有框架中发现，苹果为 Siri 设计了两套接入第三方 AI 模型的机制。

Among them, 'Model Delegation' allows Claude to act as a Siri extension, similar to the existing ChatGPT. In a demo, users selected Claude via the 'Ask…' menu and asked it to set a reminder; after Claude parsed the request, it handed it back to Siri to invoke Apple's Reminders feature. In another demo, Claude generated a CSV file in the Siri conversation window. 其中，「模型委托」可让 Claude 像现有 ChatGPT 一样作为 Siri 扩展。演示中，用户通过「Ask…」菜单选择 Claude，要求它设置提醒；Claude 解析请求后，再交回 Siri 调用苹果的提醒事项功能。另一段演示中，Claude 在 Siri 对话窗口生成了 CSV 文件。

Another mechanism is located in Model Manager Services, which can replace Siri's server-side model with GPT-5.6 Terra in demonstrations. Third-party models receive Apple's planning prompts and tool definitions, then request the system to perform operations, with Siri displaying the results. 另一套机制位于 Model Manager Services，可在演示中用 GPT-5.6 Terra 替换 Siri 的服务器端模型。第三方模型接收苹果的规划提示词和工具定义，再请求系统执行操作，由 Siri 展示结果。

These demonstrations used permissions that are not yet open. The 'Ask…' menu in the current macOS 27 Release Candidate only supports ChatGPT, the Claude extension is not yet available to users, and Apple has not opened model delegation permissions to third parties. 这些演示使用了尚未开放的权限。当前 macOS 27 候选发布版的「Ask…」菜单仅支持 ChatGPT，Claude 扩展尚未向用户提供，苹果也没有向第三方开放模型委托权限。

item.title: 特斯拉公布 Cybercab 京沪展期，仅作静态展示
item.guid: 特斯拉公布-Cybercab-京沪展期，仅作静态展示
item.description:
Tesla announced the specific exhibition arrangements for its Cybercab autonomous electric vehicle in Beijing and Shanghai on September 14, with exhibitions starting on September 17 in both locations. 特斯拉 9 月 14 日公布赛博无人驾驶电动车 Cybercab 在北京、上海的具体展览安排，两地均于 9 月 17 日开始展出。

The Beijing exhibition is located at the China World Tesla Experience Store and will run until September 27; the Shanghai exhibition is located on the LG1 North Hall of HKRI Taikoo Hui and will run until September 21. The end dates for the two locations differ. 北京展览设在华贸特斯拉体验店，持续至 9 月 27 日；上海展览位于兴业太古汇 LG1 层北厅，持续至 9 月 21 日。两地结束时间不同。

The Cybercab is a two-seater model designed specifically for autonomous taxis, without a steering wheel or pedals. Tesla reminds that the Beijing and Shanghai events are static displays only; the launch of products and services in various regions is still subject to factors such as planning, local regulations, and regulatory approvals. Cybercab 是专为无人驾驶出租车设计的双座车型，不配备方向盘和踏板。特斯拉提醒，京沪活动仅为静态展示；产品及服务在各地区的推出仍受计划、当地法规与监管批准等因素影响。

item.title: iQOO 公布三星 M16 屏幕方案，计划 iQOO 16 首发
item.guid: iQOO-公布三星-M16-屏幕方案，计划-iQOO-16-首发
item.description:
According to IT Home's on-site report, iQOO held a screen technology communication meeting at Samsung's South Korean headquarters on September 14, introducing a display solution jointly explored with Samsung, which is planned to be first featured on the iQOO 16, set to debut at the end of the month. 据 IT 之家现场报道，iQOO 9 月 14 日在三星韩国总部举行屏幕技术沟通会，介绍与三星联合探索的显示方案，计划由月底登场的 iQOO 16 首次搭载。

The new solution uses Samsung M16 luminous material, offering 2K resolution and a 165Hz refresh rate. Announced brightness indicators include a manual maximum of 1100 nits, a global maximum of 2800 nits, and a local peak of 10000 nits; local peak brightness is not equivalent to the sustained brightness of the entire screen. 新方案采用三星 M16 发光材料，提供 2K 分辨率与 165Hz 刷新率。公布的亮度指标包括手动最高 1100 尼特、全局最高 2800 尼特，以及局部峰值 10000 尼特；局部峰值不等同于整块屏幕持续显示的亮度。

Regarding touch, the solution announced an instantaneous sampling rate of 5000Hz, a multi-finger sampling rate of 500Hz, and support for 3300Hz PWM dimming. This event introduced the screen technology solution; the full phone launch will still be later. 触控方面，方案公布瞬时采样率 5000Hz、多指采样率 500Hz，并支持 3300Hz PWM 调光。此次活动介绍的是屏幕技术方案，手机整机发布仍在之后。

item.title: 国产捉宠 RPG《伊莫》开启 PC 预下载，9 月 16 日上线
item.guid: 国产捉宠-RPG《伊莫》开启-PC-预下载，9-月-16-日上线
item.description:
The official website of 'Imo' announced the start of PC pre-download on September 14, and the game will officially launch on September 16. Previously announced arrangements were for PC and console versions to launch first, with the mobile version launching on September 23. 《伊莫》官网 9 月 14 日宣布开启 PC 端预下载，游戏将于 9 月 16 日正式上线。此前公布的安排为 PC 与主机端先行，移动端于 9 月 23 日上线。

This is a multiplayer online open-world pet-catching RPG, developed by Hangzhou Clawmark and published by Shanghai Quletang. Players explore different regions on the continent of Aedel, search for creatures called 'Imo', and can also combine with Twine to act from the perspective and abilities of these creatures. 这是一款多人在线大世界捉宠 RPG，由杭州爪印开发、上海趣乐糖发行。玩家在艾德尔大陆探索不同区域、寻找名为「伊莫」的生物，还可以通过 Twine 联结合体，以这些生物的视角和能力行动。

飞行、潜水与遁地等能力被用于世界探索，场景还包含昼夜、天气变化和房车营地。游戏采用免费游玩模式；本次开放的是预下载，正式游玩仍需等待上线。

item.title: WorkBuddy 升级 PPT 能力，支持沿用模板和局部修改
item.guid: WorkBuddy-升级-PPT-能力，支持沿用模板和局部修改
item.description:
腾讯 WorkBuddy 官方公众号公布 PPT 能力升级。用户可输入一个主题，或上传文档、固定模板及参考 PPT，由 WorkBuddy 梳理内容主线、生成页面和演讲备注，输出可继续编辑的 .pptx 文件。

据官方介绍，这次升级重点改善页面布局、配色、数据图表和多页风格一致性。使用公司或学校模板时，可要求沿用主题色、字体层级和已有页面结构；参考某份 PPT 的整体风格或单页排版，也能作为生成依据。

第一版生成后，用户可在「人机双写」中点选或框选标题、文本框、图片和图表，要求拆页、改图表或调整样式，也可直接手动修改文件，保留满意的页面。生成结果还可进入腾讯文档继续协作、评论和多端编辑。

item.title: 宇树发布 G1+，新增颈部自由度与持续外部供电
item.guid: 宇树发布-G1+，新增颈部自由度与持续外部供电
item.description:
宇树科技 9 月 14 日公布人形机器人 G1+，在 G1 基础上升级运动性能、感知交互与供电。官网显示，标准版配备 25 个关节电机自由度，整机重约 35kg，站立高度为 1340mm。

运动方面，G1+ 新增 2 个颈部自由度，头部可俯仰和左右转动。肩部与腰部电机的峰值扭矩提升 110%，手臂峰值扭矩提升 43%；官方同时公布了同扭矩条件下的发热下降数据。

感知系统采用双目相机、广角相机与 3D 激光雷达，头部增加触摸传感器，支持触碰触发交互。语音部分升级为前 4 后 2 的六麦克风阵列，支持声源定位，并配备腰部双 10W 扬声器。

G1+ 还增加了持续外部供电能力，面向科研、展示等长时间运行场景。EDU 版可扩展腰部与手部自由度，支持二次开发及额外计算模块。

item.title: 于东来回应四年合同制：工作和劳资方面严格按劳动法执行
item.guid: 于东来回应四年合同制：工作和劳资方面严格按劳动法执行
item.description:
9 月 14 日，胖东来创始人于东来在社交平台回应「新员工实行四年合同制」的讨论，表示未来四年合同制学员的目的是培养人才，工作和劳资方面将严格按照劳动法执行。

据第一财经报道，于东来此前在 9 月 13 日提出，今后新招员工为学员性质，合同四年、不续签，希望培养人才走向社会，特别专业的人才可留企担任培训师傅。

对于这项招聘安排，澎湃新闻记者 9 月 14 日以求职者身份致电胖东来官方客服，工作人员表示，正式招聘尚未开始。这次回应补充了用工合规表态，但没有公布完整招聘方案。

item.title: 钟薛高 508 件无形资产完成转移，原社交账号将注销
item.guid: 钟薛高-508-件无形资产完成转移，原社交账号将注销
item.description:
据界面新闻报道，9 月 14 日，钟薛高食品（上海）有限公司管理人发布情况说明，确认此前整体拍卖的 508 件无形资产已完成权利转移，原公司使用这些资产注册的社交媒体账号将陆续注销。

公告列出的资产包括 492 项注册商标、8 项授权专利与 8 项著作权。它们于今年 5 月 7 日经拍卖成交，上海市第三中级人民法院在 6 月 4 日作出裁定，确认相关权利归买受人所有。

管理人表示，买受人有权合法使用这些资产，后续在各平台开设账号等行为及相应法律责任由买受人承担，与原公司及管理人无关。此次公告确认了资产交接和账号处置安排，并非新主体恢复生产或产品重新上市的公告。

item.title: 商务部公开智能家居消费方案，地方可自主确定补贴标准
item.guid: 商务部公开智能家居消费方案，地方可自主确定补贴标准
item.description:
商务部等 8 部门于 9 月 14 日公开《促进智能家居消费行动方案》，提出扩大智能家居供给、完善标准、支持消费及发展适老化产品。文件印发日期为 9 月 2 日。

补贴方面，方案按照今年消费品以旧换新政策部署，支持地方结合实际自主合理确定智能家居产品补贴品类、补贴标准，统筹支持全屋智能家居购新，并用好个人消费贷款财政贴息政策。文件没有设定全国统一的智能家居补贴比例。

互联互通也被列为重点：加快制定实施智能家居互联互通等强制性国家标准，推动全屋智能一体化融合；推动基础电信企业自有环境的家庭宽带网络设备默认开启 IPv6，提升家庭网络连通率，并鼓励新建全装修住宅光纤到房间布设。

供给端将支持家居卖场、购物中心设立全屋智能样板间，打造基于国内开源操作系统的软硬件产品和一体化方案。适老化方向包括家庭服务机器人、健康监测和智能照护，并要求关注操作便利、方言识别及安全性能。回收服务则鼓励家居企业与回收企业合作，提供「送新 + 收旧」等服务。

item.title: 上周全国票房降至 3.3 亿元，两部经典重映片进入市场
item.guid: 上周全国票房降至-3.3-亿元，两部经典重映片进入市场
item.description:
据财新援引国家电影专资办数据，9 月 7 日至 13 日，全国电影市场票房为 3.3 亿元，环比下降 33%，没有一部影片的周票房超过 1 亿元。

9 月上映的经典重映片中，《肖申克的救赎》半月取得 2087 万元票房，《杀死比尔：血色全传》取得 3598 万元票房。

《肖申克的救赎》是 1994 年上映的作品，豆瓣评分为 9.7 分，位列 Top 250 榜首；《杀死比尔》则来自昆汀·塔伦蒂诺的系列作品。两部旧作重返院线，但上周市场整体规模仍较前一周收缩。

item.title: RTÉ、BBC 续订《The Walsh Sisters》第二季
item.guid: RTÉ、BBC-续订《The-Walsh-Sisters》第二季
item.description:
据 Deadline 报道，爱尔兰公共广播机构 RTÉ 已批准《The Walsh Sisters》第二季，BBC 将继续在英国播出，澳大利亚观众可通过 Stan 收看。新一季现已开拍。

这部喜剧剧情剧改编自爱尔兰作家 Marian Keyes 的小说，围绕都柏林一个混乱却彼此依恋的家庭展开，把五姐妹的生活困境与喜剧元素交织在一起。Stefanie Preissner 继续负责改编，并与 Caroline Menton、Danielle Galligan、Máiréad Tyers 和《德里女孩》主演 Louisa Harland 一同回归，饰演五姐妹。

第二季新增演员包括《Bad Sisters》的 Peter Coonan、《普通人》的 Aislín McGuckin，以及 Art Campion 和 Fay Ripley。Aidan Quinn 与 Carrie Crowley 继续饰演姐妹们的父母。

新剧情中，Rachel 将独立面对康复生活，Claire 挑战母亲身份的传统期待，Anna 尝试走出失恋，姐妹们各自的生活变化仍与家庭关系紧密相连。该剧由 Cuba Pictures 与 Metropolitan Pictures 制作，Cineflix Rights 负责全球发行。

item.title: 《Cunk on Cinema》发布首图，迈克尔·贝与本尼迪克特接受采访
item.guid: 《Cunk-on-Cinema》发布首图，迈克尔·贝与本尼迪克特接受采访
item.description:
据 Variety 报道，戴安娜·摩根饰演的 Philomena Cunk 将在三集伪纪录片《Cunk on Cinema》中回顾电影史，新作已发布首张剧照，并公布受访阵容。

迈克尔·贝与本尼迪克特·康伯巴奇将接受 Cunk 的采访。其他受访者包括《挽救计划》配乐师 Daniel Pemberton、《虎胆龙威》编剧 Steven E. de Souza、摄影指导 Seamus McGarvey，以及影评人 Mark Kermode、纪录片导演 Mark Cousins。

节目延续《Cunk on Earth》等系列的喜剧形式，从摄影机的发明、20 世纪 60 年代新浪潮，讲到 CGI 与 AI 对电影的影响。查理·布鲁克领衔编剧，Al Campbell 执导，摩根也参与写作。

英国观众可通过 BBC Two 和 BBC iPlayer 观看；英国、爱尔兰以外由 Netflix 提供。
